scenarios.when: an alias resolves to multiple exact model IDs
scenarios.then: ask the user to choose an exact ID; do not submit

scenarios.when: a user asks for text-to-image with the default model, a uniquely resolved installed alias, or an exact model ID using only known core fields
scenarios.then: submit directly without reading /v1/media/models first

scenarios.when: the Images API explicitly rejects a model, parameter, or capability and returns no task ID
scenarios.then: read the catalog at most once for diagnosis, show returned current candidates or allowed values, and require an explicit corrected new request; never resubmit automatically

scenarios.when: the Images API returns 429 before a task ID is confirmed
scenarios.then: report Retry-After when returned, ask the user to wait and explicitly retry, and do not poll, wait, or retry automatically

scenarios.when: a submission has a 5xx response, transport error, or timeout before a task ID is confirmed
scenarios.then: state that task acceptance is unknown, do not claim the task was not created, and never automatically resubmit

scenarios.when: an on-demand live catalog read, used only for an installed-profile gap or post-rejection diagnosis, lacks the exact image ID or capability
scenarios.then: state that the model is unavailable or unauthorized and list returned catalog candidates; do not resubmit or switch models

scenarios.when: the installed selection and any permitted one-time on-demand catalog read have no schema for a requested n, size, image_size, aspect ratio, reference field, or other optional parameter
scenarios.then: explain that the model parameter profile is not published, ask the user to remove that option or choose a model with an explicit profile, and do not submit that unverified option

scenarios.when: a requested optional parameter is absent from the installed or on-demand schema, or its value violates the declared enum or range
scenarios.then: list the profile-supported values and ask the user to choose one; do not submit

scenarios.when: a one-time live catalog read is needed for an explicit unsupported option, media operation, or diagnosis but fails
scenarios.then: report that read failure; do not let it block a normal core text-to-image submission, and do not retry or resubmit automatically

scenarios.when: a direct fixed-Pure-Tokens API request fails before task acceptance or native image bytes cannot be handed off
scenarios.then: report the returned failure or delivery state, state whether a task_id was returned, and do not guess a configuration cause or submit a replacement task

scenarios.when: the requested count is not allowed by the exact authenticated model's input_schema.properties.n
scenarios.then: explain the one-task limit, list the profile-declared count values or range, and ask for a supported count; do not submit

scenarios.when: a requested pixel canvas, semantic image size, aspect ratio, or other image parameter is not declared by the exact authenticated model profile
scenarios.then: list the profile-declared options for that field and ask the user to choose one; do not submit

scenarios.when: the request uses a physical dimension such as 200cm x 230cm
scenarios.then: explain that physical dimensions cannot be guaranteed and ask for a supported pixel canvas; do not submit

scenarios.when: the user attaches an image and the installed or permitted on-demand profile has no compatible image_edit operation
scenarios.then: state that this exact model has not published native image-attachment capability and do not submit or switch models

scenarios.when: the user provides a public reference-image URL but the installed or permitted on-demand profile lacks a matching property and declared public-URL reference transport
scenarios.then: state that the selected model has not published a compatible public-URL reference field, list any declared reference fields, and do not submit or switch models

scenarios.when: the user provides a reference-image URL that is not a public HTTPS URL
scenarios.then: explain that the selected profile requires a public HTTPS URL and ask the user to provide one; do not submit

scenarios.when: a reference URL contains credentials, localhost, a .local host, or an explicit loopback, private, or link-local IP
scenarios.then: reject it as non-public without DNS lookup or probing and ask for a public HTTPS URL; do not submit

scenarios.when: more than one exact authenticated public-URL reference field could represent the user's request
scenarios.then: list the declared fields and ask the user to choose the intended input mode; do not guess or submit

scenarios.when: an image-edit profile requires multipart_file but the active runtime cannot send the user's explicit attachment bytes with the direct API request
scenarios.then: stop before submission, explain that attachment-byte delivery is unavailable, and do not read credentials, create a URL, or downgrade to text-to-image

scenarios.when: the active runtime can send the user's current multipart image attachment through the declared Images API operation
scenarios.then: send it only with that single direct Images API request; Pure Tokens stages the attachment internally to short-lived R2, waits for a readable public HTTPS URL, and never exposes that URL to the user

scenarios.when: an edit request includes a mask, multiple references, or another field not explicitly declared by the installed or permitted on-demand image_edit profile
scenarios.then: list the declared operation limits and ask the user to adjust the request; do not submit

scenarios.when: a submission returns an installed lifecycle create.idField such as top-level id, or otherwise top-level task_id or id
scenarios.then: report that opaque value under the receipt field task_id and use it only as a percent-encoded status/content path segment

scenarios.when: a submission response has no declared lifecycle ID field and no top-level task_id or id
scenarios.then: report that task_id was not returned and cannot be safely continued; do not derive one from URLs or nested data, poll, download, or resubmit

scenarios.when: a continuation request provides a URL, multiple IDs, or an empty task ID
scenarios.then: ask for exactly one opaque task ID and do not extract, concatenate, or query an ID

scenarios.when: a status response has no declared lifecycle classification and its status is not a documented fallback state
scenarios.then: report the raw state as unrecognized, stop automatic polling, and require an explicit same-task continuation before another status read

scenarios.when: a task continuation has no trustworthy original requested n
scenarios.then: ask the user for the original image count before content delivery; do not guess indexes or report partial delivery as complete

scenarios.when: the same task is in an installed-lifecycle pending state or a documented fallback processing state
scenarios.then: report the current state and continue reading only that task

scenarios.when: the same task is in an installed-lifecycle pending state or a documented fallback processing state
scenarios.then: honor a valid positive Retry-After delay when returned; otherwise wait 3, 6, 12, 24, then 30 seconds, with at most six same-task status reads during a submission or explicit same-task continuation turn

scenarios.when: a task is in an installed-lifecycle pending state or a documented fallback processing state
scenarios.then: keep at most one same-task status request in flight, never create a background timer or queue, and stop automatic polling after a rate limit, 5xx, transport error, or timeout

scenarios.when: 120 seconds have elapsed since a task submission response and the task is still in an installed-lifecycle pending state or a documented fallback processing state
scenarios.then: report the current state, stop automatic polling, and require an explicit user request to continue the same task; do not resubmit

scenarios.when: the user explicitly asks to continue querying the returned task_id
scenarios.then: start a new bounded polling window for that same task only; do not submit, inspect, or substitute another task

scenarios.when: the same task reports failure, cancellation, or expiry
scenarios.then: report the returned failure and require an explicit new request before another submission

scenarios.when: the status request times out or the submission outcome is unknown
scenarios.then: report the uncertainty, offer to continue querying the same task if an ID exists, and never auto-resubmit

scenarios.when: a task is complete but native content cannot be delivered
scenarios.then: report the delivery failure and offer only a same-task content retry; do not claim success

scenarios.when: a multi-image task has delivered some but not every requested zero-based content index from 0 through n-1
scenarios.then: report the delivered and missing indexes, offer only same-task retrieval for the missing indexes, and never resubmit

scenarios.when: a completed task has multiple image results
scenarios.then: read zero-based content indexes sequentially, hand off each native byte result before the next read, and do not prefetch, concurrently fetch, or re-fetch delivered content
